svg.title: Stack
svg.desc: Technologies Manthan builds with. Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, C++, Java, SQL. Interface: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Vite, PWA. Services: Node.js, Express, FastAPI. Data: PostgreSQL, Supabase, SQLite, Prisma. Cloud: AWS, Google Cloud, Vercel, Docker. Ai: Gemini API, Prompt engineering, LLM evaluation, RAG. Tooling: Git, GitHub, pytest
